summary_en: ROE target raised to 15%+ (from 10%); cost of equity estimate raised to ~10% (from ~7%); equity ratio target ~60% (from 70%+); cash ratio to <20% (from 25-30%); FY26 ROE projected ~16%; mid-term plan execution and market focus on components, battery, energy, mobility segments.
title_en: Disclosure on Initiatives Toward Realizing Capital-Cost and Stock-Price-Conscious Management
translation_en_brief: Hioki E.E. Corporation disclosed on 7 August 2026 an update to its cost-of-capital targets and capital management guidelines. The company revised upward its estimate of shareholder cost of equity from ~7% (6–8% range) to ~10% (10% range) based on 2024 dialogues with shareholders and investors. In line with this revision, the company raised its ROE target from 10%+ to 15%+ in February 2025. The disclosure confirms FY2025 actual ROE of 13.0%, which exceeded the cost-of-equity estimate of ~10%, and projects FY2026 ROE of ~16%. The company introduced balance-sheet guidelines targeting (i) cash and deposits at ≤20% of consolidated assets (currently managed at 25–30%) and (ii) equity ratio of ~60% (currently ~70%+) to optimize weighted average cost of capital. Strategic execution focuses on mid-term plan delivery and sales expansion in four priority markets: components, battery, energy, and mobility. The stock price and market capitalization have improved since Q1 FY2026 following earnings announcements and clarified growth strategy communication.
